parsed.rationale: Both participating records are located under test paths — `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/NowPlayingServiceTests.swift` and `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift` — and both carry the name `MockArtworkService`, which is a canonical mock fixture name. Even though the Jaccard similarity is 0.75 (indicating substantial structural overlap), the restraint rule requires no-action whenever any participating record is a test fixture. Consolidating these mocks into a shared location would couple two independent test targets (`AppServicesTests` and `ArtworkTests`) through a shared mock, which risks introducing unwanted test-target dependencies and obscuring each suite's isolation intent.
